cover.note: House 3's gate on a grey winter morning: a messenger hands an order slip to a clerk under the portico; behind, a loader lifts a grain sack beside the board of numbered slots.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic photograph with the same camera, composition and landforms: looking along the portico of a Hellenistic Greek trading house on a stone quay: on the left the house's wall of rough grey rubble stone, overhead timber beams under a tiled lean-to roof, on the right plain Doric columns and the sea. Winter day under low grey overcast: soft flat light, no sun, no hard shadows, cloud low on the hills. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its messenger and pouch exactly. Under the portico the messenger hands a small folded papyrus slip to a clerk in a plain grey-blue tunic holding a wax tablet. Behind them on the portico wall, a long timber board with a row of open wooden slots, each marked with a Greek letter-numeral (Α, Β, Γ, Δ…), never Arabic digits, some holding small clay tablets, a short wooden peg standing in one slot; beside it a loader in a coarse brown tunic lifts a grain sack. No other people. Nothing modern.

b01-goatherd.note: The goatherd on a track high on the spur above House 2's harbour, pointing down to the port; the cliff road round the bay below.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic photograph with the same camera, composition and landforms: a small Hellenistic Greek port town of stone houses with terracotta roofs below a steep hillside, a long stone pier in the harbour, the sea beyond. Replace every smooth placeholder shape with real maquis, pine, rock, stone and roof tile. The buildings are modelled: keep every building's shape, roof, doors and windows where they are, with walls of rough grey rubble stone and dressed corner stones under terracotta roofs. Winter late morning under low grey overcast, cloud low on the hills: soft flat light, no hard shadows. In the foreground on a narrow stony goat track among the scrub: a weathered goatherd in a rough undyed wool tunic and a sheepskin cape, holding a crook, with four or five goats around him, pointing down toward the town. Below, a narrow road cut into the hillside runs round the bay into the town. Deep focus, all sharp. No other people. Nothing modern.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a 3D model, into a photorealistic photograph with exactly the same camera, composition and architecture: looking along the portico of a Hellenistic Greek trading house on a stone quay. On the left the house's wall of rough grey rubble stone; overhead timber beams under a tiled lean-to roof; on the right plain Doric columns and the sea beyond; ahead a timber storehouse door standing open and grain sacks. Real weathered stone, timber and tile. Winter day under low grey overcast: soft flat light, no hard shadows. On the wall, the long timber board at chest height: a row of twelve open wooden slots, each marked with a painted Greek letter-numeral (Α, Β, Γ, Δ…), never Arabic digits; the first five hold small clay tablets, and a short wooden peg stands beside them. Two clerks, one in a grey-blue tunic and one in an olive tunic, reach for neighbouring slots at once; a loader in a coarse brown tunic walks towards us along the portico with a grain sack on his shoulder. No other people. Nothing modern.
